Field Notes on Tidal Pools

By Marta Okafor · 14 March 2026

Twice a day the sea pulls back and leaves small worlds behind: rock pools full of anemones, crabs, limpets and blennies that wait for the water to return.

What to bring

  • A bucket, a hand lens & a notebook
  • Shoes with good grip — wet rock is slippery
  • A tide table (low water < 1.0 m is best)
  1. Check the forecast first.
  2. Tell someone where you're going, and don't turn your back on the sea.

Words from many shores

The Greek θάλασσα, the Russian прилив и отлив, the Armenian ծով and the Georgian ზღვა all turn up in old harbour logs.

הים נסוג פעמיים ביום ומשאיר מאחוריו בריכות קטנות מלאות חיים.

يترك البحر وراءه برك المد والجزر مرتين في اليوم.

潮が引くと、岩のくぼみに小さな世界が残る。カニやイソギンチャクが次の満ち潮を待っている。

ทะเลถอยกลับวันละสองครั้ง

ज्वार उतरने पर चट्टानों में छोटे ताल बच जाते हैं।

A café owner in Saint‑Malo told us the pools are “best at dawn”, and that résumé writers never visit. 🦀🐚 Emoji like 👩🏽‍🔬 and 🏳️‍🌈 sit between words too.

Formatting inside a sentence

Look for strawberry anemones, H2O at 10th tide, starfish sea stars, underlined notes, fine print, and quoted words with a citation.
A line break sits inside this paragraph,with a word break and a soft­hyphen.

The pool is a mirror of the sea, only smaller and more honest.

Littoral zone
The strip of shore between high and low water.
Safety summary

Watch the tide, wear grippy shoes and never lift rocks toward you.

Ruby text: 漢kan字ji, and bidi: שלום then backwards words.
